title: Figure 6: Autocatalytic thermonuclear detonation using soft X-ray precursor
description: Cross-section diagram captioned 'Figure 6. Autocatalytic Thermonuclear Detonation Using a Soft X-ray Precursor From the Burn Zone BZ to Precompress the Thermonuclear Fuel TF Ahead of the Detonation Front DF. The soft x-rays travel through the gap G between the tamp T and the liner L.' Labels include 'Soft X-rays', BZ, DF, TF, T, G, L and velocity Vo. It accompanies the section 'Neutron Entrapment in an Autocatalytic Thermonuclear Detonation Wave'.
